categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label, edits `src/wallet/wallet.cpp` rebroadcast logic, and refactors `wallet_resendwallettransactions.py`.
categories.rationale: Mitigates a long-standing wallet transaction origin and IP privacy leak caused by unconditional periodic rebroadcasts of transactions already retained in the local mempool.
